function_v0.doc:
Atomic swap between USDM0 and USDM1.

Always requires a USDM1 price attestation. The contract uses
`INDEX_SCALE` as USDM0's fixed conversion index; this is not an on-chain
verification of its market peg. The signed swap permit binds the swapper
as source, input token, output token, amount, nonce, and validity window.
The broker pulls input by allowance, burns the broker-held input, and
mints output in one transaction.
function_v0.name: swap_tokens

function_v0.doc: Advance the version marker without clearing existing configuration or replay state.
function_v0.name: migrate_to_v3

function_v0.doc:
Atomic redemption using a replay-protected permit and any required price attestations.

Atomic redemption: consumes the permit, transfers collateral from the
beneficiary to the recipient, and burns USDM in one transaction.
Collateral is pulled from the configured beneficiary with `transfer_from`;
that address must grant the broker sufficient allowance.
function_v0.name: redeem

function_v0.doc:
Queue a redemption for manual processing.

The queued path uses the same redemption nonce lane as `redeem`,
escrows USDM in the contract, and records one pending redemption per
redeemer. Fee, whitelist, and redemption-limit policies are not enforced
on chain; any such checks are the responsibility of the trusted signer
or another off-chain control.
function_v0.name: queue_redemption

function_v0.doc:
Cancel a pending queued redemption and return escrowed USDM.

The redeemer can cancel their own pending redemption; the assigned operator
can also cancel it as an operational escape hatch.
function_v0.name: cancel_redemption

function_v0.doc:
Operator-only processing of a pending queued redemption.

On success, processing burns the escrowed USDM and transfers collateral
from the beneficiary to the queued recipient. The ID-keyed record and the
per-redeemer pending index are removed before the cross-contract token
calls. If a later call fails, Soroban rolls back the deletions and token
operations atomically.
function_v0.name: process_redemption

function_v0.doc:
Atomic deposit using a replay-protected permit and any required price attestations.

`source` authorizes the Soroban invocation, while the signed permit
binds the source, recipient, collateral, USDM token, amount, nonce, and
validity window.

- Verifies a collateral price attestation when the collateral requires it;
otherwise the contract uses `INDEX_SCALE`.
- Verifies a USDM1 price attestation when minting USDM1; USDM0 uses
`INDEX_SCALE`.
- Verifies and consumes the deposit permit (signed by trusted signer).
- Converts amount via price indices, transfers collateral from `source`
to beneficiary through allowance, and mints USDM to `recipient`.

This contract does not enforce fees, whitelist eligibility, or policy
limits. A configured trusted signer is expected to apply any required
off-chain policy before issuing the permit. Permit nonces are consumed;
price quote IDs are not replay-protected.
function_v0.name: deposit
